  • Engaging positions on unique, cutting-edge data center projects
  • Comprehensive training and a dream team
  • Supportive dynamic environment
  • Competitive hourly rate
  • Ability to collaborate remotely
  • Equipment for work (Starlink terminal, EcoFlow power station, other).
  • Transparent payment system.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Provide direct support to the HR Manager in daily operations, helping manage workload and ensure smooth execution of tasks.
  • Act as a first point of contact for employees, handling routine questions on benefits, policies, and HR processes, and escalating when needed.
  • Support core HR processes, including time-off administration, employee lifecycle activities, and HR documentation.
  • Assist with coordination of performance reviews, scheduling, tracking progress, and sending reminders.
  • Help organize and follow up on HR priorities, ensuring tasks and deadlines are effectively managed.
  • Maintain accurate employee records and HRIS data.
  • Coordinate recruitment activities, including interview scheduling and candidate communication.
  • Assist with payroll and benefits administration, particularly for US-based employees.
  • Collaborate with international teams and support HR reporting and administrative tasks.

Requirements:

  • 2+ years of experience in a similar HR support role.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office Package.
  • English proficiency: C1 level or higher (required), with strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience working with US-based HR processes is beneficial.
  • Basic experience with HR reporting and data tracking.
  • Ability to communicate clearly and professionally with international, cross-cultural teams, including US stakeholders.
  • Capable of explaining HR policies and processes in a simple, supportive manner, with a high level of responsiveness and organization.


Why Us?

  • Cutting-edge data center projects in a fast-growing industry.
  • Opportunity to collaborate with industry-leading professionals and firms.
  • Competitive terms of the contract
  • A dynamic environment fostering creativity through exposure to diverse technologies and experiences. This ranges from designing energy-efficient facilities, site supervision for multi-million-dollar facilities, to the production of digital twins, drawings, three-dimensional building modeling, computational fluid dynamics, and the development of custom control software.

Apply today and help us achieve our international engineering goals!

Ehvert Mission Critical specializes in the design and construction management of data centers. We are a business unit within Salas O’Brien - a 4,000-person engineering and professional services firm, widely recognized for its extensive expertise and impressive project portfolio. With more than 10,000 projects annually and 100 offices across North America, Salas O'Brien is ranked #39 on Engineering News-Record’s 2024 Top 500 Design Firms list.

Ehvert Mission Critical, a business unit within Salas O’Brien, is an industry leader in data center facility engineering, specializing in hyperscale and AI data centers, designing massive data centers for global tech giants like Microsoft, Uber, Oracle, and Amazon. Our projects involve complex electrical, mechanical, automation, and security systems necessary to power, cool, and secure these high-demand facilities, often exceeding loads of 100 MW per facility and up to 500 MW per site.

We are recognized for our advanced engineering and construction techniques, including Building Information Modeling (BIM), Virtual Design and Construction (VDC), and augmented reality.

We offer high competitive service fees to our independent contractors.

This engagement is strictly as an independent contractor. You will not be eligible for any employee benefits, and we will not withhold taxes, provide insurance(s), or make contributions to social security/pensions on your behalf. You are responsible for complying with all tax and labor obligations in your country of residence. A formal independent contractor agreement will be required before work begins, governed by Texas, United States law.

This role is centered on the practical architecture, deployment, and optimization of Large Language Models (LLMs), RAG systems, and AI Agents in a production environment.   • Best Practices: Implement and enforce best practices for LLM integration, optimization, security, and monitoring.

Qualifications

Technical Expertise

  • AI Core: 5+ years of experience Hands-on experience with LLMs, AI agents, embeddings, RAG systems, vector databases, and prompt engineering.
  • Primary Language: Fluent in Python (primary) for all stages of the ML lifecycle.
  • Secondary Language: Strong experience with JavaScript/TypeScript (secondary) for integration work.
  • Tools: Experience with vector database technologies (Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, or similar).
  • DevOps: Strong Git version control and collaborative development practices, with familiarity in Docker/containerization.
  • Cloud: Strong experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) for AI deployment.

Soft Skills & Professionalism

Work Schedule

  • Preferred Shift: 4:00 AM 12:00 PM EST (perfect alignment for overlapping collaboration).

Building on the work already underway, this is a rare opportunity to strengthen our commercial positioning, enhance the overall client experience, and elevate our Marketing & Communications efforts.

About the role

Are you a seasoned B2B marketing leader who thrives at the intersection of strategic vision and meticulous execution? Can you translate complex consultancy business models into revenue-driving campaigns while inspiring a lean, capable team?

Working closely with the Senior Management Team and reporting directly to the Managing director, you will take full ownership of our Marketing & Communications strategy for this 6-9 month period, ensuring every initiative is deeply aligned with our commercial goals and revenue generation. You will oversee and mentor an agile, in-house team of 2 FTE, providing high-level direction while remaining ready to roll up your sleeves and bring ideas to life when it matters most.

This is a multi-faceted role, requiring a combination of sharp strategic Marketing & Communications knowledge, skills and experience, strong stakeholder collaboration, and a keen appreciation of how to bring ideas to life in a fast-paced environment, across a small global organisation.

Our values in action

As a values-driven organisation, our core values shape how we work, collaborate, and deliver impact. During this cover period, you will lead by example, embodying and championing these values across the team:

  • Deliver Excellence: You aim to ‘WOW’ our customers, co-workers, contractors, and partners with top-tier strategic campaigns.

  • Empathetic: You lead with a human-centric approach - listening, reflecting, empathising, and maintaining open, honest communication.

  • Connected: You deeply value collaboration, teamwork, and building genuine personal relationships across our global team.

  • Diverse: You embrace diversity in skills, scope, and across environmental, financial, legal, gender, and social criteria to enrich our brand voice.

  • Impactful: You ensure our short-term marketing decisions are guided by long-term impacts, learning from past experiences to maximise our reach.

  • Driven: You are persistent, determined, and passionate about what we do, bringing high energy to our commercial growth.

Location: Remote, +4,-4 GMT time

LoE: 2/3 days per week for 6 to 9 months (40-60% LoE)

Key Responsibilities

  • Commercial strategy and positioning: Analyse and elevate our product offerings, market placement and commercial positioning. Translate complex business models into a highly targeted, revenue-focused marketing strategy.

  • Client experience and journey: Champion the customer experience, building on the work done to map out the client journey to ensure targeting is precise, highly relevant, and engaging for our specific client base.

  • Inbound marketing and discoverability: Guide the team to ensure our website and other digital assets drive inbound business. Implement robust SEO and discoverability strategies so that our business is easily found by prospective clients.

  • Thought leadership and brand momentum: Lead exceptional thought-leadership initiatives. Orchestrate and support multi-channel B2B strategic campaigns across the organisation - specifically from the Consulting, Bid and HR teams. Manage our brand reputation through high-quality strategic campaigns.

  • Business development alignment: Act as a core advocate for strategic marketing input in business development actively collaborating with the Managing director and Senior management team to complete the Marketing plans for 2026 / 2027.

  • Team leadership and execution: Guide, brief and mentor our internal Marketing & Communications team who will report to you directly, though you will not be directly responsible for the day-to-day tactical execution. Lead the weekly Marketing & Communications meetings, one-to-ones, and participate in the Senior management team weekly meetings and strategy sessions. Blend high-level strategic orchestration with hands-on execution such as new and existing strategic campaigns, driving brand momentum to ensure ideas are brought to life in a fast-paced global environment.

Requirements

  • Marketing & Communications leadership: At least 8 years of proven B2B marketing experience with 5 or more years in leadership or fractional CMO roles. Proven experience scaling high-performing teams in a multi-cultural, international environment.

  • Commercial strategy and positioning: Experience translating complex business models into strategy.

  • Industry knowledge: Understanding of the climate finance and sustainable development landscape, challenges and opportunities.

  • Cross-channel success: A track record of successfully leading, developing and overseeing complex cross-channel strategies in a multi-national context. Experience briefing and managing creative professionals and agencies.

  • Hands-on capability: Extensive hands-on skills in Product marketing, Growth marketing, Brand positioning, Messaging, SEO & Lead generation.

Marketing Operations Specialist

Remote UK

Do you want to help shape software that affects thousands of lives?

Who are we?

We are ranked as the UK’s #1 construction specific software player and our mission is simple; to provide market leading end-to-end software solutions to the construction and construction like industries across the entire build life cycle.

If you are looking to build an exceptional career with an award-winning company you’ve come to the right place. Our teams are based in the UK, Europe, and India, working on products that are used on a global scale. We have a clear and defined road map to deliver over the next 3 years, which is centred around a large-scale digital transformation as well as continuing our growth and expansion.

We embrace diversity and equality and want our employees to be comfortable bringing their whole selves to work. We are committed to building a team with a variety of backgrounds, skills and views. Creating a culture of Equality isn’t just the right thing to do, it improves every aspect of our business.

Purpose

This role is responsible for owning and managing Causeway’s marketing systems, data, and automation, acting as the central hub across Marketing, Sales, and the Business Unit Marketers to build the operational foundations our go-to-market strategy depends on. Day-to-day, this means building HubSpot workflows, owning data builds and campaign assets, enriching and segmenting our contact database, and ensuring the wider team is working from a single source of truth with clean, consistent data and well-defined processes at every stage of the funnel.

You’ll also play a key part in defining how we operate as an AI-first marketing function, helping shape and implement our AI-first marketing automation strategy, advising the wider marketing team on AI processes, and raising the overall maturity of how we use technology. As the team’s authority on our MarTech stack, you’ll ensure our tools are fit-for-purpose as we scale and that we’re staying ahead of what’s possible.

This role supports UK and international marketing teams across the US and Europe, as well as the broader business.

Key Responsibilities

Marketing Automation, Campaign Execution & GTM Support

·Work closely with Business Unit Marketers on data builds and campaign execution, translating strategic priorities into well-structured, accurately targeted programmes.

·Build and manage HubSpot workflows, lists, sequences, and nurture programmes that support demand generation activity.

·Create campaign assets including emails, landing pages, forms, and automated workflows for Business Unit Marketers.

·Own the lead scoring model, keeping it calibrated, fit-for-purpose, and continuously refined as our understanding of buyer behaviour improves.

·Troubleshoot the lead management process end-to-end, ensuring all flows are working correctly and leads are progressing through the right stages accurately.

·Support the product communications process, ensuring timely and well-executed outreach.

Data Management & Segmentation

·Own the target segment data strategy, defining system properties, working with external data partners, and regularly enriching and refreshing our contact database.

·Ensure our data is well-structured, accurately segmented, and maintained to a standard that supports confident GTM decision-making.

·Build background process workflows to maintain a clean, well-structured lead management architecture.

·Troubleshoot data quality, integration, and system issues raised by the wider team.

Reporting & Performance Analytics

·Produce marketing reports and dashboards that measure campaign performance, funnel health, pipeline contribution, and overall marketing effectiveness.

·Apply statistical analysis and A/B test interpretation to surface insights and make performance improvement recommendations.

·Address modelling and forecasting needs across the marketing team, helping the business plan with greater confidence.

Systems, Technology & AI

·Act as HubSpot super user, ensuring the platform is correctly used, maintained at the right level of maturity, and updated as the platform evolves.

·Help define and implement an AI-first marketing automation strategy, identifying opportunities to embed AI into workflows, processes, and how the team operates day-to-day.

·Serve as the team’s go-to adviser on AI processes, guiding Business Unit Marketers on how to incorporate AI effectively into their own workflows.

·Periodically review the MarTech stack to ensure it remains fit-for-purpose as the business scales, evaluating new tools and retiring those that no longer serve us.

·Train and implement AI bots and tools to improve team efficiency, documentation, and how we use our tech stack.

·Administer sales enablement platforms and ensure task and project management tooling is configured and fit-for-purpose.

Team Enablement & Process Improvement

·Own the onboarding and training of new Marketing team members on systems, processes, and automation.

·Proactively identify and act on opportunities to improve marketing operations processes, with a focus on AI-driven efficiency gains.

·Create and manage initiatives to gather and share internal and external marketing best practices across the team.

Key Skills, Experience and Qualifications

Essential

·2–3 years’ minimum experience with CRM and marketing automation platforms; HubSpot experience is a strong advantage.

·Hands-on experience building workflows, lists, and campaign assets in a marketing automation platform.

·Strong data skills: comfortable with data collection, manipulation, segmentation, and enrichment.

·Analytical mindset with experience in reporting, dashboards, A/B test interpretation, and funnel ROI analysis.

·Comfortable with Excel, including pivot tables, graphs, and basic modelling.

·Process-oriented, with the ability to connect operational detail to broader business outcomes.

·Actively uses AI to improve processes, team efficiency, and data organisation, and is curious about where it can go next.

·Able to work at pace in a dynamic environment and adapt quickly as priorities shift.

Desirable

·Experience in construction tech or a B2B SaaS environment.

·Familiarity with sales enablement platforms and marketing tech stack management.

·A degree with a mathematical or analytical component.

What you get from us:

raw.description:
IBEX is a well-funded start-up with a global presence and headquarters in the USA and Israel. Ibex develops state-of-the-art artificial intelligence solutions for cancer diagnostics. Our cutting-edge technology is transforming the diagnosis of cancer, leading to rapid and accurate decision-making and providing new diagnostic insight to enable precision medicine.

Our world-class team of researchers, engineers, and medical experts is growing. If you are an outstanding professional, passionate about your work, a team player, and want to make a difference in the lives of millions of people – come join us. You will get the opportunity to work on novel and challenging problems and help us fight cancer while doing it!

About the Role:

The Head of Precision Diagnostics will be a pivotal leader responsible for driving the growth of Ibex’s biopharma business by identifying, shaping, and securing high-value strategic partnerships. This role demands a rare blend of deep clinical credibility and sharp market strategy rooted in precision medicine. Acting as the intellectual engine of our Biopharma business, you will translate complex clinical needs into AI-driven solutions, map out high-potential pharma pipelines, and lead the scientific and strategic engagement. Utilizing your deep expertise in oncology biomarkers and companion diagnostics (CDx), you will align Ibex's capabilities with pharma drug development and commercialization needs. The ultimate measure of success for this role is accelerating pipeline velocity and successfully securing strategic partnerships and commercial deals with biopharma companies.

Key Responsibilities:

Strategic Alliances & Deal Generation

  • Secure Strategic Partnerships: Drive the end-to-end strategic engagement process with biopharma, from identifying key stakeholders to translating clinical needs into structured opportunities, with the ultimate goal of securing commercial deals.

  • Market & Pipeline Mapping: Systematically analyze the biopharma landscape, clinical trials, and drug pipelines to identify the assets, oncology targets, and companies that have the highest strategic need for Ibex’s AI precision diagnostic and biomarker capabilities.

  • Scientific Positioning & Value Proposition: Define and articulate scientifically robust use cases that demonstrate how Ibex’s AI accelerates oncology biomarker development, patient stratification, and companion diagnostic (CDx) strategies.

  • Thought Leadership: Position Ibex and its leadership as premier thought leaders in the AI precision diagnostics space by representing the company at major industry conferences, symposia, and digital platforms.

Product Strategy & Cross-Functional Alignment

  • Capture Voice of Customer (VOC): Directly engage with biopharma partners to deeply map their pain points, clinical workflow challenges, and biomarker discovery needs.

  • Asset Optimization & Solution Building: Formulate immediate, high-value offerings leveraging Ibex's existing AI assets while building structured business cases for these solutions.

  • Future Product Roadmap Guidance: Act as the internal strategic bridge for the biopharma segment; identify future technological requirements based on market gaps, translating them into actionable feedback for internal R&D teams to expand Ibex’s core capabilities.

  • Competitive Intelligence: Maintain an exhaustive, real-time understanding of the competitive landscape, ensuring Ibex’s offerings remain highly differentiated.

  • Scientific Publication Roadmap: Partner closely with Ibex’s internal clinical and medical teams to build and drive a strategic roadmap of scientific publications. This involves identifying key data generation opportunities that validate the clinical utility of Ibex's AI solutions, effectively positioning the company as the premier clinical partner of choice for biopharma organizations.

  • Regulatory Contribution: Collaborate with internal regulatory teams to contribute to the overarching regulatory strategy for the biopharma business, specifically regarding companion diagnostic (CDx) development pathways.

Requirements

  • Education: Ph.D. or M.D. in Life Sciences, Oncology, Pathology, Molecular Diagnostics, or a highly related field is a strict requirement to command immediate clinical and scientific credibility with partners.

  • Experience: Minimum of 7+ years of experience in corporate strategy, scientific alliances, medical affairs, or strategic business development within the biopharma or precision medicine sectors.

  • Domain Expertise: Proven track record and deep, hands-on experience in oncology biomarker development and companion diagnostics (CDx). Must have a thorough understanding of how assays and biomarkers are integrated into clinical trials and drug development workflows.

  • The "Hybrid" Skillset: Demonstrated ability to understand complex AI/digital pathology technology and translate it seamlessly into a high-value business case for pharma drug development.

  • Communication & Influence: Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence and persuade executive-level scientists, clinicians, and commercial leaders alike.

  • Regulatory Knowledge (Preferred): Familiarity or experience contributing to regulatory strategy and CDx approval pathways (e.g., FDA/EMA frameworks) is highly desirable.

  • Travel: Willingness to travel as required to engage with partners and lead presence at industry events.
